title: Most news apps are built to keep you scrolling as long as possible.
body:
We decided to build the opposite. At Headlinne, our philosophy is simple. We want to help you get informed, not addicted. The modern news cycle is designed to manufacture anxiety, but we believe you can stay up to date without feeling overwhelmed.

We use AI to strip away the noise. Instead of pushing the most sensational headlines that trigger an emotional reaction, our technology focuses on clarity and context. It learns what you actually care about and filters out the clutter that doesn't matter to your day.

True personalization isn't about feeding you more of the same. It is about respecting your time. When you open an app, you should find what you need quickly and then get back to your life. That is the standard we are setting for ourselves.
cta: See how we are changing the way you read at HEADLINNE.com.
